# Was ist numerische Mathematik?

## Gleichungen mit einer Unbekannten

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
$$
    (x - 1)^2 = 1
$$
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(4, 2.5))
plt.plot(x, (x - 1)**2)
plt.plot(x, np.ones_like(x))
plt.scatter([0, 2], [1, 1], color="tomato", zorder=3)
plt.show()
```
:::
::::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
$$
    \sin x = \frac{x}{2}
$$
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(4, 2.5))
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.plot(x, x / 2)
plt.scatter([0, 1.8955], [0, 0.9477], color="tomato", zorder=3)
plt.show()
```
:::
